summary: P01 V2.47.123 Navigation continuous collection rail. Based on OWNER Production screenshot and mature bookmark-manager sidebar research, removes the Navigation visibility block from the left rail and moves visibility into the collection toolbar as a compact filter. The left side becomes one uninterrupted library-view to category flow, with divider lines and card-like search styling removed. Navigation IA, bookmark rows, Shared Shell, Home, Channels and all other surfaces remain unchanged. No schema, data, auth mechanism, updater, provider, server, or Production write.
